Caitlin Clark won the most recent Time Magazine's Athlete of the Year award, for the year 2024 [d1][d5][d8]. She was recognized for her record-breaking performances in both college basketball and her WNBA rookie season with the Indiana Fever, where she set multiple records including the all-time WNBA assists record in a single season [d5][d6]. Clark was also the WNBA Rookie of the Year and the first rookie named to the All-WNBA first team since 2008 [d5]. According to Time's own coverage, Clark's impact on women's basketball was described as unprecedented, with WNBA attendance jumping 48% and the league delivering its most-watched regular season in 24 years [d1][d6][d9].
